g.text: Title: 01 | Switched power and 5 V regulation

g.desc: Title: 01 | Switched power and 5 V regulation

g.text: Sheet: /01 | Switched power and 5 V regulation/

g.desc: Sheet: /01 | Switched power and 5 V regulation/

g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.text: SUPPLY: vehicle 12 V through retained factory fused feeds; voltage regulation inside ECM. Existing onboard F1 is retained as a separate draft protection element. Retain factory fuse protection; input current budget and transient/reverse-polarity performance require validation.

g.desc: SUPPLY: vehicle 12 V through retained factory fused feeds; voltage regulation inside ECM. Existing onboard F1 is retained as a separate draft protection element. Retain factory fuse protection; input current budget and transient/reverse-polarity performance require validation.

g.text: POWER REVIEW: nominal 5 V / 500 mA architecture, inherited from the V3.0 approach.

g.desc: POWER REVIEW: nominal 5 V / 500 mA architecture, inherited from the V3.0 approach.

g.text: At 14 V and 0.35 A the regulator dissipates about 3 W; thermal design is unresolved.

g.desc: At 14 V and 0.35 A the regulator dissipates about 3 W; thermal design is unresolved.

g.text: This protection circuit has not passed reverse battery, cranking, load dump or EMC testing.

g.desc: This protection circuit has not passed reverse battery, cranking, load dump or EMC testing.

g.text: Fuse, PTC and bulk-capacitor footprints remain blank pending exact part selection.

g.desc: Fuse, PTC and bulk-capacitor footprints remain blank pending exact part selection.

g.text: VPWR feeds logic only. Injector, coil and transmission load supplies remain externally fused.

g.desc: VPWR feeds logic only. Injector, coil and transmission load supplies remain externally fused.
